description: At night the Castle of Loarre stands silent on its rocky ridge in the Pyrenean foothills — one of the oldest castles in Spain, its 11th-century Romanesque walls, towers and the church of San Pedro with its dome outlined against the starry sky. A few warm lights glow from the fortress while the dark hills fall away below. From this frontier stronghold Sancho Ramírez once prepared the conquest of Huesca; it later became an Augustinian abbey.
